neighbours.label: Descartes's line quoted in a Descartes frame, at ' think' or at the comma after it
fire: Descartes famously wrote "I think, therefore I am" in his study.
As Descartes put it, "I think, therefore I am" and no more.
Rene Descartes said "I think, therefore I am" long ago.
Cartesian doubt ends with "I think, therefore I am" for certain.
Descartes argued that "I think, therefore I am" cannot be doubted.
The philosopher Descartes wrote "I think, therefore I am" in Latin too.
In Descartes, "I think, therefore I am" comes first.
Students of Descartes learn "I think, therefore I am" early.
quiet: My aunt often wrote "I think we are late" in her notes.
As my boss put it, "I think we need more" and no more.
Her mother said "I think it will rain" long ago.
The long talk ends with "I think that is all" for certain.
The coach argued that "I think we can win" is not a plan.
The teacher Ms Hall wrote "I think so too" in pencil.
In my diary, "I think of home" comes first.
Students of French learn "I think it is good" early.

notes: Second round. In round 1 ' think' in quotes framed with Descartes fired (0.49-0.54), while the same word in other quotes stayed at 0.02 or below.
